stateDefinitions.OPEN_AUTHORITY_DEPENDENT: Count/content cannot be safely fixed yet without upstream Story/visual/human authority.
stateDefinitions.PENDING_CONTENT_MIGRATION: A new production policy exists but old generated-row/read-model structure has not yet been rewritten on latest main.
